what: A drone synth made for playing live: the sound of FIKH-S (22 algorithms, now 22 rooms of a dungeon) under four macros that do the same in every room: TONE, MOVE, GRIT, SPACE, each with a sweetspot in the middle. A GROOVE of dungeon noises instead of drums (heartbeat, footsteps, drips, chains, wings, ritual, bell, bones, rumble, torch), tuned to the drone, with a soft pump that makes the drone breathe. HOLD, FREEZE, DICE, 8 snapshots, MIDI clock.
author: swtdr34mz
